description: This file defines a singleton class 'GlobalVariables' extending Android's Application class, which holds global state variables such as driver ID, vehicle ID, weather info, location coordinates, and receipt count, accessible throughout the Android app.

classes.name: GlobalVariables
classes.description: A class extending Application to manage global state variables related to driver, vehicle, weather, and location.

methods.name: getLatitude
methods.description: Returns the current latitude stored in the global variables.

methods.name: setLatitude
methods.description: Sets the latitude in the global variables.

methods.name: getLongitude
methods.description: Returns the current longitude stored in the global variables.

methods.name: setLongitude
methods.description: Sets the longitude in the global variables.

methods.name: getDriverLastConnection
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last driver connection.

methods.name: setDriverLastConnection
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the last driver connection.
